heading: If you or someone you love is pregnant
intro: Most of these emergencies - heavy bleeding, high blood pressure, severe anaemia - can be survived with fast, skilled care and available blood. Knowing the danger signs and reaching a facility that can act quickly is what makes the difference.

heading: If you work in maternity care
intro: Near-misses outnumber deaths roughly eight to one, and reviewing them shows where care slips. Protocol-based team management protected women here; blood shortages and delays cost lives.

heading: If you shape maternal health policy
intro: The gaps are concrete and fixable: emergency obstetric readiness, a dependable blood supply, and prompt referral. Tracking near-misses, not just deaths, would give a far earlier warning.
